Methods:

Cellranger:

Raw single-cell RNA-sequencing data were processed on a Linux high-performance computing server using Cell Ranger v7.0.1 (10x Genomics). FASTQ files from three datasets, 1538TE10H11, 1538TE10H13, and JH4327_01_TE10H13, were processed independently using the cellranger count pipeline. For each library, reads were aligned to the mouse reference genome (mm10) using the 10x Genomics reference package refdata-gex-mm10-2020-A.

For each sample, Cell Ranger was run with identical parameters, specifying the corresponding sample identifier, FASTQ directory, and reference transcriptome. Alignment, barcode processing, UMI collapsing, and gene expression quantification were performed using default Cell Ranger settings. Computational resources were allocated as 15 CPU cores and 120 GB of RAM per sample to ensure efficient processing of large libraries.

The resulting gene-by-cell count matrices, cell barcode annotations, and quality control metrics generated by Cell Ranger were used as input for all downstream analyses performed in R.


QC and integration in R:


Comments:

3 datasets in the Seurat object:
"1538TE10H11"   - Removed POA and Septum cells (n=3064, pbmc_old Seurat object)    
"1538TE10H13"   - Removed POA and Septum cells (n = 1374, pbmc_old Seurat object)
"JH4327_01_TE10H13" - Integrated later (n=3347 cells)

# Pseudocode


POA and Septum cells removal

```{r}
## ============================================================
## Load required libraries
## ============================================================

library(Seurat)        # Core single-cell analysis framework
library(scAnnotatR)    # SVM-based cell type classification
library(cowplot)       # Plot composition
library(tidyverse)     # Data manipulation and plotting

## Use SCT-normalized data for marker inspection and DE
DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "SCT"


## ============================================================
## Helper function: identify cells with high expression of a gene
## ============================================================
## This function identifies cells expressing a given gene
## within the upper quantile of its non-zero expression distribution.
## This is used as a conservative heuristic to pre-label cells
## for supervised classifier training.

cells_expressing_gene <- function(seurat_obj, gene, quantile_cutoff = 0.8) {

  # Extract expression vector for the gene from SCT-normalized data
  expr <- seurat_obj@assays$SCT@data[gene, , drop = TRUE]

  # Remove cells with zero expression
  expr <- expr[expr > 0]

  # Retain only cells above the specified quantile
  expr <- expr[expr > quantile(expr, quantile_cutoff)]

  # Return cell barcodes
  names(expr)
}


## ============================================================
## Helper function: train and apply an SVM classifier
## ============================================================
## This function:
## 1. Uses heuristic marker-positive cells as training labels
## 2. Randomly splits data into train/test sets
## 3. Trains an SVM classifier using scAnnotatR
## 4. Evaluates classifier performance (ROC/AUC)
## 5. Applies the classifier to the full dataset

train_and_apply_svm <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  positive_cells,
  marker_genes,
  label_name,
  assay = "RNA",
  seed = 1234
) {

  # Create temporary metadata label for supervised training
  seurat_obj[[label_name]] <- ifelse(
    Cells(seurat_obj) %in% positive_cells,
    label_name,
    "Other"
  )

  # Randomly split cells into training and test sets (50/50)
  set.seed(seed)
  pivot <- ncol(seurat_obj) %/% 2
  train_cells <- sample(colnames(seurat_obj), pivot)
  test_cells  <- setdiff(colnames(seurat_obj), train_cells)

  train_set <- seurat_obj[, train_cells]
  test_set  <- seurat_obj[, test_cells]

  # Train SVM classifier using raw RNA counts
  classifier <- train_classifier(
    train_obj    = train_set,
    tag_slot     = label_name,
    cell_type    = label_name,
    marker_genes = marker_genes,
    assay        = assay
  )

  # Evaluate classifier performance on held-out test data
  test_res <- test_classifier(
    classifier = classifier,
    test_obj   = test_set,
    assay      = assay,
    tag_slot   = label_name
  )

  message(label_name, " SVM AUC: ", round(test_res$overall_roc, 3))

  # Apply trained classifier to the full dataset
  full_pred <- test_classifier(
    classifier = classifier,
    test_obj   = seurat_obj,
    assay      = assay,
    tag_slot   = label_name
  )

  # Return classifier and predicted positive cell barcodes
  list(
    classifier  = classifier,
    predictions = rownames(filter(full_pred$pred, class == 1))
  )
}


## ============================================================
## POA cell identification
## ============================================================

# Canonical POA marker genes
POA_markers <- c("Igfbp5", "Dbx1", "Hmx3")

# Heuristic preselection of POA-like cells
POA_cells_initial <- unique(c(
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Igfbp5", 0.8),
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Dbx1",  0.8),
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Hmx3",  0.8)
))

length(POA_cells_initial)

# Differential expression to validate POA identity
POA_vs_non_POA <- FindMarkers(
  pbmc,
  ident.1 = POA_cells_initial,
  ident.2 = setdiff(Cells(pbmc), POA_cells_initial),
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

head(POA_vs_non_POA, 20)

# Train and apply POA SVM classifier
POA_svm <- train_and_apply_svm(
  seurat_obj     = pbmc,
  positive_cells = POA_cells_initial,
  marker_genes   = POA_markers,
  label_name     = "POA"
)

POA_cells <- POA_svm$predictions
length(POA_cells)


## ============================================================
## Septum cell identification
## ============================================================

# Canonical septal marker genes
Septum_markers <- c("Spry1", "Fgf8", "Zic4")

# Heuristic preselection of septal-like cells
Septum_cells_initial <- unique(c(
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Spry1", 0.5),
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Fgf8",  0.5),
  cells_expressing_gene(pbmc, "Zic4",  0.5)
))

length(Septum_cells_initial)

# Differential expression to validate septal identity
Septum_vs_non_Septum <- FindMarkers(
  pbmc,
  ident.1 = Septum_cells_initial,
  ident.2 = setdiff(Cells(pbmc), Septum_cells_initial),
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

head(Septum_vs_non_Septum, 20)

# Train and apply septum SVM classifier
Septum_svm <- train_and_apply_svm(
  seurat_obj     = pbmc,
  positive_cells = Septum_cells_initial,
  marker_genes   = Septum_markers,
  label_name     = "Septum"
)

Septum_cells <- Septum_svm$predictions
length(Septum_cells)


## ============================================================
## Resolve overlapping classifications and assign final labels
## ============================================================

# Cells classified as both POA and septum
POA_and_Septum <- intersect(POA_cells, Septum_cells)

# Assign final cell type labels
pbmc$SVM_cell_type <- "MGE"
pbmc$SVM_cell_type[POA_cells] <- "POA"
pbmc$SVM_cell_type[Septum_cells] <- "Septum"
pbmc$SVM_cell_type[POA_and_Septum] <- "POA_or_Septum"

table(pbmc$SVM_cell_type)


## ============================================================
## Remove POA and septal contaminants
## ============================================================

# Retain only bona fide MGE cells for downstream analysis
pbmc_MGE <- subset(pbmc, SVM_cell_type == "MGE")

pbmc_MGE


```

Full reintegration
```{r}

# featuresPN
# tf_genes


# Function to normalize and reintegrate datasets starting from subsetted data
reintegrate_datasets <- function(subset_obj) {
  # Split the Seurat object by dataset
  split_objs <- SplitObject(subset_obj, split.by = "dataset")
  
  # Perform SCTransform normalization on each dataset
  split_objs <- lapply(split_objs, SCTransform)
  
  # Find integration anchors
  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split_objs, nfeatures = 3000)
  split_objs <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = split_objs, anchor.features = features)
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = split_objs, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = features)
  
  # Integrate the datasets
  integrated2 <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
  
  # Add the new integrated assay to the original Seurat object
  subset_obj[["integrated2"]] <- integrated2[["integrated"]]
  
  return(subset_obj)
}


# Reintegrate first
pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(subset(pbmc_projN, cellID == "Proj_neu",  features = featuresPN))
#pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(subset(pbmc_projN, cellID == "Proj_neu",  features = tf_genes))
pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(subset(pbmc_projN, cellID == "Proj_neu", features = NULL))


recluster_data_geneset <- function(gene_set){
  
    pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(subset(pbmc_projN, cellID == "Proj_neu",  features = gene_set))  
  
    DefaultAssay(pbmc_sub_rint) <- "integrated2"

    PCs <- 25
  
    # Perform PCA
    pbmc_sub_rint <- RunPCA(pbmc_sub_rint, npcs = PCs)

    # Perform UMAP
    pbmc_sub_rint <- RunUMAP(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs, min.dist = 0.01)

    # Find Neighbors
    pbmc_sub_rint <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs)

    # Find Clusters
    pbmc_sub_rint <- FindClusters(pbmc_sub_rint, resolution = 0.8)

    pbmc_sub_rint

}


pbmc_sub_rint_PN <- recluster_data_geneset(gene_set = featuresPN)
pbmc_sub_rint_TF <- recluster_data_geneset(gene_set = tf_genes)
pbmc_sub_rint_All <- recluster_data_geneset(gene_set = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Function to normalize and reintegrate datasets starting from subsetted data
reintegrate_datasets <- function(subset_obj) {
  # Split the Seurat object by dataset
  split_objs <- SplitObject(subset_obj, split.by = "dataset")
  
  # Perform SCTransform normalization on each dataset
  split_objs <- lapply(split_objs, SCTransform)
  
  # Find integration anchors
  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split_objs, nfeatures = 3000)
  split_objs <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = split_objs, anchor.features = features)
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = split_objs, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = features)
  
  # Integrate the datasets
  integrated2 <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
  
  # Add the new integrated assay to the original Seurat object
  subset_obj[["integrated2"]] <- integrated2[["integrated"]]
  
  return(subset_obj)
}

recluster_data_geneset_no_reint <- function(data, gene_set){
  
    pbmc_sub_rint <- subset(data, features = gene_set)  
  
    DefaultAssay(pbmc_sub_rint) <- "RNA"
    pbmc_sub_rint <- SCTransform(pbmc_sub_rint)
    
    DefaultAssay(pbmc_sub_rint) <- "SCT"

    PCs <- 25
  
    # Perform PCA
    pbmc_sub_rint <- RunPCA(pbmc_sub_rint, npcs = PCs)

    # Perform UMAP
    pbmc_sub_rint <- RunUMAP(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs, min.dist = 0.01)

    # Find Neighbors
    pbmc_sub_rint <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs)

    # Find Clusters
    pbmc_sub_rint <- FindClusters(pbmc_sub_rint, resolution = 0.8)

    pbmc_sub_rint

}
```

```{r}

# Assuming pbmc_PN@meta.data is your data frame
d <- pbmc_PN@meta.data[,c("seurat_clusters","age")]

# Calculate total number of cells for each age group
total_cells_per_age <- d %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n())

# Merge total cell counts with the original data
d <- d %>%
  left_join(total_cells_per_age, by = "age")

# Calculate proportions
proportions <- d %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, age, total_cells) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / total_cells * 100)

# Plot
ggplot(proportions, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = percentage, fill = age)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  labs(y = "Percentage", title = "Cell Proportions by Age for Each Seurat Cluster") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

```{r}

## Reintegration function. Reintegration is using the default 3000 variable features
reintegrate_datasets <- function(subset_obj) {
  # Split the Seurat object by dataset
  split_objs <- SplitObject(subset_obj, split.by = "dataset")
  
  # Perform SCTransform normalization on each dataset
  split_objs <- lapply(split_objs, SCTransform)
  
  # Find integration anchors
  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split_objs, nfeatures = 3000)
  split_objs <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = split_objs, anchor.features = features)
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = split_objs, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = features)
  
  # Integrate the datasets
  integrated2 <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
  
  # Add the new integrated assay to the original Seurat object
  subset_obj[["integrated2"]] <- integrated2[["integrated"]]
  
  return(subset_obj)
}




## Reclustering function with optional gene_set subsetting
recluster_data_geneset_w_reint <- function(data, gene_set = NULL, PCs = 25) {
  
  # Subset only if gene_set is provided
  data_to_use <- if (!is.null(gene_set)) subset(data, features = gene_set) else data

  # Reintegrate
  pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(data_to_use)

  # Proceed with standard integration analysis
  DefaultAssay(pbmc_sub_rint) <- "integrated2"
  
  #PCs <- 25
  
  pbmc_sub_rint <- RunPCA(pbmc_sub_rint, npcs = PCs)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- RunUMAP(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs, min.dist = 0.01)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- FindClusters(pbmc_sub_rint, resolution = 0.8)

  return(pbmc_sub_rint)
}
```

E11 vs E13 markers

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

#Idents(pbmc_MZ_recl) <- "seurat_clusters"

# Function to run DE for one cluster
run_DE <- function(clust) {
  cells_in_cluster <- WhichCells(pbmc_MZ_recl, idents = clust)
  cluster_obj <- subset(pbmc_MZ_recl, cells = cells_in_cluster)
  Idents(cluster_obj) <- "age"
  
  # only run if both timepoints exist
  if (all(c("E11", "E13") %in% unique(cluster_obj$age))) {
    de <- FindMarkers(cluster_obj,
                      ident.1 = "E11",
                      ident.2 = "E13",
                      logfc.threshold = 0.25,  # require |log2FC| ≥ 0.25
                      min.pct = 0.25,          # expressed in ≥25% of cells
                      test.use = "wilcox")
    de$cluster <- clust
    de$gene <- rownames(de)
    return(de)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}



# Run DE across all clusters with lapply
de_results_list <- lapply(levels(pbmc_MZ_recl$seurat_clusters), run_DE)

# Combine into one dataframe
de_results_df <- bind_rows(de_results_list)

# Preview
head(de_results_df)

write.csv(de_results_df, file = "C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/DE_tables/MZ_E11_vs_E13_reclustered_markers_on_52_PN_genes_08_15_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Function to generate violin plot for a given cluster
plot_cluster_violin <- function(cluster_number, de_results_df, seurat_object, top_n = 70) {
  
  # 1. Subset DE results for the cluster
  de_cluster <- de_results_df %>% dplyr::filter(cluster == cluster_number)
  
  # 2. Select top positive and negative markers
  top_pos <- de_cluster %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Up in E11")
  top_neg <- de_cluster %>% arrange(avg_log2FC) %>% slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Up in E13")
  
  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_pos, top_neg)
  
  # 3. Extract expression data for these genes
  cells_cl <- WhichCells(seurat_object, idents = cluster_number)
  expr_mat <- FetchData(seurat_object, vars = c(top_genes$gene, "age"), cells = cells_cl)
  
  # Reshape to long format
  expr_long <- pivot_longer(expr_mat, 
                            cols = all_of(top_genes$gene),
                            names_to = "gene", 
                            values_to = "expression")
  
  # Add direction info
  expr_long <- expr_long %>% 
    left_join(top_genes %>% dplyr::select(gene, direction), by = "gene")
  
  # 4. Generate plot
  p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = age)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~direction, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ylab("Expression") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("E11" = "#1f78b4", "E13" = "#e31a1c")) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Cluster ", cluster_number))
  
  return(p)
}

# Example: generate plots for clusters 0 through 5
cluster_numbers <- 0:13
cluster_plots <- lapply(cluster_numbers, plot_cluster_violin, 
                        de_results_df = de_results_df, 
                        seurat_object = pbmc_MZ_recl,
                        top_n = 70)

# Optional: name the list by cluster
names(cluster_plots) <- paste0("Cluster_", cluster_numbers)

cluster_plots
```

```{r}

## Reintegration function. Reintegration is using the default 3000 variable features

reintegrate_datasets <- function(subset_obj) {
  # Split the Seurat object by dataset
  split_objs <- SplitObject(subset_obj, split.by = "dataset")
  
  # Perform SCTransform normalization on each dataset
  split_objs <- lapply(split_objs, SCTransform)
  
  # Find integration anchors
  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split_objs, nfeatures = 3000)
  split_objs <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = split_objs, anchor.features = features)
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = split_objs, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = features)
  
  # Integrate the datasets
  integrated2 <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
  
  # Add the new integrated assay to the original Seurat object
  subset_obj[["integrated2"]] <- integrated2[["integrated"]]
  
  return(subset_obj)
}






## Reclustering function with optional gene_set subsetting
recluster_data_geneset_w_reint <- function(data, gene_set = NULL, PCs = 25) {
  
  # Subset only if gene_set is provided
  data_to_use <- if (!is.null(gene_set)) subset(data, features = gene_set) else data

  # Reintegrate
  pbmc_sub_rint <- reintegrate_datasets(data_to_use)

  # Proceed with standard integration analysis
  DefaultAssay(pbmc_sub_rint) <- "integrated2"
  
  #PCs <- 25
  
  pbmc_sub_rint <- RunPCA(pbmc_sub_rint, npcs = PCs)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- RunUMAP(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs, min.dist = 0.01)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_sub_rint, dims = 1:PCs)
  pbmc_sub_rint <- FindClusters(pbmc_sub_rint, resolution = 0.8)

  return(pbmc_sub_rint)
}
```

```{r}
CellCycleScoring <- function(
  object,
  s.features,
  g2m.features,
  ctrl = NULL,
  set.ident = FALSE,
  ...
) {
  name <- "Cell.Cycle"
  features <- list("S.Score" = s.features, "G2M.Score" = g2m.features)

  # Determine the number of control features if not specified
  if (is.null(ctrl)) {
    ctrl <- min(vapply(X = features, FUN = length, FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)))
  }

  # Calculate module scores for S and G2M phases
  object.cc <- AddModuleScore(
    object = object,
    features = features,
    name = name,
    ctrl = ctrl,
    ...
  )

  # Extract the module score columns
  cc.columns <- grep(pattern = name, x = colnames(object.cc[[]]), value = TRUE)
  cc.scores <- object.cc[[cc.columns]]

  # Cleanup
  rm(object.cc)
  CheckGC()

  # Assign cell cycle phases
  assignments <- apply(
    X = cc.scores,
    MARGIN = 1,
    FUN = function(scores, first = "S", second = "G2M", null = "G1") {
      if (all(scores < 0.1)) {
        return(null)
      } else if (length(which(scores == max(scores))) > 1) {
        return("Undecided")
      } else {
        return(c(first, second)[which(scores == max(scores))])
      }
    }
  )

  # Combine scores with assignments
  cc.scores <- merge(x = cc.scores, y = data.frame(assignments), by = 0)
  colnames(cc.scores) <- c("rownames", "S.Score", "G2M.Score", "Phase")
  rownames(cc.scores) <- cc.scores$rownames
  cc.scores <- cc.scores[, c("S.Score", "G2M.Score", "Phase")]

  # Add results to the object
  object[[colnames(cc.scores)]] <- cc.scores

  # Optionally set cell identity to the assigned phase
  if (set.ident) {
    object[["old.ident"]] <- Idents(object)
    Idents(object) <- "Phase"
  }

  return(object)
}


```

E11 vs E13 markers

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

#Idents(pbmc_MZ_recl) <- "seurat_clusters"

# Function to run DE for one cluster
run_DE <- function(clust) {
  cells_in_cluster <- WhichCells(pbmc_VZ_SVZ_recl, idents = clust)
  cluster_obj <- subset(pbmc_VZ_SVZ_recl, cells = cells_in_cluster)
  Idents(cluster_obj) <- "age"
  
  # only run if both timepoints exist
  if (all(c("E11", "E13") %in% unique(cluster_obj$age))) {
    de <- FindMarkers(cluster_obj,
                      ident.1 = "E11",
                      ident.2 = "E13",
                      logfc.threshold = 0.25,  # require |log2FC| ≥ 0.25
                      min.pct = 0.25,          # expressed in ≥25% of cells
                      test.use = "wilcox")
    de$cluster <- clust
    de$gene <- rownames(de)
    return(de)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}



# Run DE across all clusters with lapply
de_results_list <- lapply(levels(pbmc_VZ_SVZ_recl$seurat_clusters)[1:9], run_DE) # Skipping cluster 9 due to only 2 cells in one group

# Combine into one dataframe
de_results_df <- bind_rows(de_results_list)

# Preview
head(de_results_df)

write.csv(de_results_df, file = "C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/DE_tables/VZ_SVZ_E11_vs_E13_reclustered_markers_on_221_progenitor_genes_08_18_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Function to generate violin plot for a given cluster
plot_cluster_violin <- function(cluster_number, de_results_df, seurat_object, top_n = 70) {
  
  # 1. Subset DE results for the cluster
  de_cluster <- de_results_df %>% dplyr::filter(cluster == cluster_number)
  
  # 2. Select top positive and negative markers
  top_pos <- de_cluster %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Up in E11")
  top_neg <- de_cluster %>% arrange(avg_log2FC) %>% slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Up in E13")
  
  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_pos, top_neg)
  
  # 3. Extract expression data for these genes
  cells_cl <- WhichCells(seurat_object, idents = cluster_number)
  expr_mat <- FetchData(seurat_object, vars = c(top_genes$gene, "age"), cells = cells_cl)
  
  # Reshape to long format
  expr_long <- pivot_longer(expr_mat, 
                            cols = all_of(top_genes$gene),
                            names_to = "gene", 
                            values_to = "expression")
  
  # Add direction info
  expr_long <- expr_long %>% 
    left_join(top_genes %>% dplyr::select(gene, direction), by = "gene")
  
  # 4. Generate plot
  p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = age)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~direction, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ylab("Expression") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("E11" = "#1f78b4", "E13" = "#e31a1c")) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Cluster ", cluster_number))
  
  return(p)
}

# Example: generate plots for clusters 0 through 5
cluster_numbers <- 0:8
cluster_plots <- lapply(cluster_numbers, plot_cluster_violin, 
                        de_results_df = de_results_df, 
                        seurat_object = pbmc_MZ_recl,
                        top_n = 70)

# Optional: name the list by cluster
names(cluster_plots) <- paste0("Cluster_", cluster_numbers)

cluster_plots
```

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

top_n <- 30
cell_sampling <- 0.3

# Select top genes per cluster
top_genes_df <- de_results_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = top_n) %>%
  mutate(direction = "Up in E11") %>%
  bind_rows(
    de_results_df %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = top_n) %>%
      mutate(direction = "Up in E13")
  )

gene_list <- unique(top_genes_df$gene)

# Extract scaled expression
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(pbmc_VZ_SVZ_recl, layer = "scale.data")
gene_list_use <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(expr_mat))
expr_mat <- expr_mat[gene_list_use, , drop = FALSE]

# Metadata
cell_metadata <- pbmc_VZ_SVZ_recl@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(seurat_clusters, age)
cell_metadata <- cell_metadata[colnames(expr_mat), ]

# Exclude cluster 9
keep_cells <- cell_metadata$seurat_clusters != "9"
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, keep_cells, drop = FALSE]
cell_metadata <- cell_metadata[keep_cells, ]
cell_metadata$seurat_clusters <- droplevels(cell_metadata$seurat_clusters)
cell_metadata$age <- factor(cell_metadata$age, levels = c("E11", "E13"))

# Loop through clusters
cluster_levels <- levels(cell_metadata$seurat_clusters)

# Loop through clusters with 10% subsampling
ht_list <- lapply(cluster_levels, function(clust) {
  
  # Subset cells for this cluster
  cells_clust <- colnames(expr_mat)[cell_metadata$seurat_clusters == clust]
  if(length(cells_clust) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Sample 10% of cells (round up to at least 1)
  n_cells <- max(1, round(length(cells_clust) * cell_sampling))
  set.seed(123 + as.numeric(clust))
  sampled_cells_clust <- sample(cells_clust, n_cells)
  
  expr_mat_clust <- expr_mat[, sampled_cells_clust, drop = FALSE]
  cell_metadata_clust <- cell_metadata[sampled_cells_clust, ]
  
  # Order by age: E11 first, then E13
  ordering <- order(cell_metadata_clust$age)
  expr_mat_clust <- expr_mat_clust[, ordering, drop = FALSE]
  cell_metadata_clust <- cell_metadata_clust[ordering, ]
  
  # Colors
  age_colors <- c("E11" = "#1f78b4", "E13" = "#e31a1c")
  cluster_colors <- setNames("#66c2a5", unique(cell_metadata_clust$seurat_clusters))
  
  # Annotation
  ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Cluster = factor(cell_metadata_clust$seurat_clusters, levels = unique(cell_metadata_clust$seurat_clusters)),
    Age = cell_metadata_clust$age,
    col = list(
      Cluster = cluster_colors,
      Age = age_colors
    )
  )
  
  # Heatmap
  Heatmap(expr_mat_clust,
          name = "Scaled Expression",
          top_annotation = ha,
          cluster_rows = TRUE,
          cluster_columns = FALSE,
          show_row_names = TRUE,
          show_column_names = FALSE,
          row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
          column_split = cell_metadata_clust$age,
          column_title = paste0("Cluster ", clust, " (E11 vs E13)"))
})
```
